sources.note: MED = wordlist_or_less; comment: 'Uirina, an extinct Northern Arawakan language attested only in the wordlists of Kann:Natterer, Martius:Brasiliens'. Ramirez 2020 covers it at III:142-143.

sources.citation: Ramirez, Henri. 2001. Línguas Arawak da Amazônia Setentrional: Comparação e Descrição. Manaus: EDUA. §8.2 'Os Cariaí, os Manao, os Wirina e os Aruã', pp.517-523.
sources.note: Nothing. p.517: 'A única lista de palavra que temos desta língua encontra-se em Martius. É uma lista tão pequena que se torna difícil dizer se esta língua arawak pertence realmente à divisão Negro-Roraima.' Followed only by a Cariaí/Manao/Wirina comparative wordlist (Wirina column = Natterer); no phonology, no accent remarks.

sources.citation: Aikhenvald, Alexandra Y. 1999. The Arawak language family. In Dixon & Aikhenvald (eds.), The Amazonian Languages, 65-106. Cambridge: CUP.
sources.note: Mentions Wirina only as a language that became extinct in the 19th-20th c. (p.71); nothing on its phonology or stress.

sources.citation: von Martius, Carl Friedrich Philipp. 1867. Beiträge zur Ethnographie und Sprachenkunde Amerika's zumal Brasiliens. Bd. II: Wörtersammlung brasilianischer Sprachen / Glossaria linguarum brasiliensium. Leipzig: Friedrich Fleischer. 'UIRINA' list p.229 (pdf p.252 of the Google/archive.org scan bub_gb_B3z7W40v4oAC).
sources.note: Nothing. One page (~85 Latin-glossed items) of Natterer's vocabulary with a footnote locating the 'Horde der Uirina oder Uarira' on the Rio Marari; forms carry unexplained diacritics (collapá, idâ, camoê, dadarró, bicurô, hê tî, dáamanâ). The volume's only remark on the acute (pp.28-30) is a general Tupi-orthography note ('den Vocal zu schärfen oder die Sylbe zu betonen'), not a statement about Uirina.
Nothing; en: 'known only from the wordlists of Johann Natterer and Carl Friedrich Philipp von Martius'; pt reproduces Natterer's 1831 flora/fauna vocabulary after Ramirez 2020 vol.4.

sources.citation: Ramirez, Henri. 2020. Enciclopédia das línguas Arawak: acrescida de seis novas línguas e dois bancos de dados. Curitiba: Editora CRV. Vol. III pp.142-143 (Wiriná) and vol. 4 (Natterer vocabulary database).
